content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K, and is now rolling out to all users. Here's a look at the new features in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 brings a redesigned Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text sizes, and more.

tvOS 27 can now be installed via the Settings app on Apple TV. The update is compatible with all Apple TV 4K models (except 1st gen) — Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's new tvOS 27 update introduces the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts gets a major overhaul on tvOS, following the earlier iOS update this year. The new tvOS version of the Podcasts app fully supports Apple's video features, making it a great platform for watching video podcasts. It also features an all-new design, with a new sidebar for navigation.

Update via iPhone: A convenient change in tvOS 27 is that you can now update your Apple TV 4K directly from your iPhone. Through the Home app in iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without ever turning on your Apple TV.

Apple Music upgrade: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix lands on Apple TV as a new option that creates DJ-style mixes, perfect for parties. Hi-Res Lossless Audio is another addition for users with compatible external speaker output.

Larger text size: You can now adjust the system-wide text size through the Dynamic Type feature in the Settings app, scaling text up to suit your needs and viewing environment.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations and app launch speeds, and a more responsive Control Center.

What's missing: Siri AI and Smart Downloads

tvOS 27 notably lacks the new Siri AI assistant, with only the legacy Siri available. Rumor has it this is because the upcoming next-generation Apple TV 4K will feature hardware upgrades capable of running Siri AI.

Another absent upgrade is the "Smart Downloads" feature Apple mentioned at WWDC. tvOS has never supported downloading TV content before, so the announcement came as quite a surprise. "Smart Downloads" may actually refer to some system feature unrelated to TV shows and movies. Either way, there's no trace of it in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How's it working for you? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
